skill.summary: Debug DNS resolution and network connectivity. Use when troubleshooting DNS failures, testing port connectivity, diagnosing firewall rules, inspecting HTTP requests with curl verbose mode, configuring /etc/hosts, or debugging proxy and certificate issues.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: DNS debugging (dig/nslookup), port testing, firewall rules, curl diagnostics, /etc/hosts, proxy config, certificate troubleshooting
